idea-plugin.name: Dino Walker
idea-plugin.description:
A tiny pixel dino walks back and forth along the top edge of your terminal.

  • Type start dino in the IDE terminal to bring it out.
  • Type exit dino and a meteor takes care of it.
  • dino start / dino exit and the Dino: Start / Dino: Stop actions (Find Action) work in any shell.

Dino sprites are taken from the Chromium project (inspired by the Chromium offline page) and are licensed under the BSD-3-Clause license; see META-INF/NOTICE. This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google LLC.
